rows.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
rows.answer:
The Get Smart costs more and does more. The Get Clássica is R$ 79,90/month and the Get Smart is R$ 129,90/month [prod-ofertas-maquininha-11].

- **Get Smart:** It is an intelligent card machine that runs Android. On the device you can control stock, place orders, close tabs, load a menu and issue invoices [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-17].
- **Integration and messaging:** It can integrate with your establishment's system. It also lets the kitchen and dining room swap messages [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-17].
- **Counter use:** It can replace a computer and fiscal printer at the counter. It reconciles payments in credit, debit, store credit, QR Code or cash [sup-duvidas-get-smart-08].
- **Processing:** Getnet processes all Get Smart sales [sup-duvidas-get-smart-17].

The sources don't describe the Get Clássica's features beyond its price, so I can't give a feature-by-feature comparison. I can hand you to a human agent if you'd like more detail.

O que é a Get Smart?
A Get Smart é uma máquina de cartões inteligente. Com ela, seu dia a dia fica mais simples, fácil e muito mais digital. Você pode controlar o estoque, fazer pedidos, fechar conta, embarcar cardápio, emitir nota fiscal, tudo diretamente na máquina. Arquivos Get Smart - Getnet: Quais os diferenciais de uma Get Smart?
Quais os diferenciais de uma Get Smart?
Com um sistema de gestão integrado ele permite que não tenha a necessidade de deslocamento para consultar um estoque, o mesmo pode ser consultado diretamente na máquina. Ele permite um balcão mais limpo, onde não é necessário ter um computador e uma impressora fiscal, ele faz ambas funções. Ele permite mais rapidez no atendimento diminuindo o tempo de espera do cliente, você pode fazer o pedido, fechar a conta e emitir o cupom fiscal tudo diretamente no terminal. Com ele você tem uma conciliação com pagamentos em todas modalidades, crédito, debito, crediário, QR Code ou dinheiro. Os sistemas de gestão homologados possuem conciliação completa.

- Actions the assistant can PROPOSE; nothing runs until the customer confirms the proposal: open_support_ticket (Abre chamado técnico para um terminal do cliente. Exige confirmação.).
- High-risk actions: they need the customer's confirmation AND then the approval of a human agent (operator) before they run: request_receivables_advance (Solicita antecipação dos recebíveis agendados. Exige confirmação do cliente e aprovação de um atendente.).
- An action proposal that is not confirmed expires after 15 minutes.
- Hand the case to a human agent: opens a case with a ticket number; the agent's reply shows up in this same conversation.
- A decision on an individual case (dispute, block or release of a held amount) belongs to a human agent; the assistant does not decide it.
- Apart from these tools, the assistant does not carry out any action in the system.

rows.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
rows.answer:
The sources don't say a bank account is mandatory. They do say Pix works with a checking, savings or prepaid payment account, at different banks [sup-duvidas-59]. Getnet also offers Get Conta, a free digital account for your business. With it you can send and receive money and sell through Pix [sup-duvidas-42].

You receive Pix payments by generating a QR Code on the capture devices: physical terminals, TEF Auttar and Ecommerce [sup-duvidas-84].

The sources don't state whether a specific account is required to receive Pix sales on Getnet. I can pass your question to a human agent if you'd like.

Dúvidas e Perguntas Frequentes | Getnet: Mais respostas sobre o Pix​
O que é o Pix? E quais as vantagens?
O que é o Pix? E quais as vantagens?
O Pix é um meio de pagamento criado pelo Banco Central para fazer pagamentos e receber transferências de forma instantânea e gratuita. rows.message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
replans: records:need->faq (terminal offline/sem sinal: o passo a passo vem do manual de conexão)
rows.answer:
Your Get Clássica terminal (T1988B) is offline with no signal. It last made contact on 2026-11-03 17:56 and has been offline for 5 hours. Your other terminal, T1988A (Get Smart), is online on Wi-Fi with good signal.

For T1988B, check the SIM chip first. These are the steps from the Getnet FAQ [sup-duvidas-06]:
- With the machine off, open the cover on the back.
- Insert the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down.
- Close the cover, turn the machine on, and wait for it to connect to the data network.
- When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), the machine is ready to use.
- Run a communication test to check that the chip is connecting.

If your model also uses Wi-Fi, Getnet has user manuals by model [sup-manual-maquinas-01].

I can propose a technical support ticket for T1988B with the reason "sem_sinal". It is only a proposal. Nothing happens until you confirm, and the proposal expires after 15 minutes. Do you want me to propose it?

The sources don't cover Wi-Fi setup, weak-signal troubleshooting or the steps for the communication test. I can pass you to a human agent for those.

rows.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
rows.answer:
You can advance your sales in the Getnet Brasil app, which is always available, and using the app has no extra fees [sup-duvidas-17].

- **Automatic Advance:** If you choose the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" receiving plan, Automatic Advance is a condition for getting the exemption [sup-duvidas-102]. Getnet treats it as a credit approval process. It assesses each contract individually and decides whether to grant the product [sup-duvidas-102].
- **Through this assistant:** I can propose a request to advance your scheduled receivables. It only runs after you confirm it and a human agent approves it.

The sources don't give the advance fee or rate, or the payout timing for a manual advance. I can pass your case to a human agent if you'd like those details.

replans: records:need->faq (terminal offline/sem sinal: o passo a passo vem do manual de conexão)
rows.answer:
Your two recent declines came from the cardholders' banks or cards, not from your terminals.

- **TX1007** (yesterday, T1988A): credit, R$ 210,00, code 51. This means insufficient funds or credit limit on the card. Ask for another card or payment method.
- **TX1008** (yesterday, T1988B): debit, R$ 75,00, code 05. The issuing bank did not authorize it (generic refusal). The cardholder should contact their bank, or you can try another card.

**Terminal status:** T1988A is online with good signal. T1988B has been offline for 5 hours, with no signal on the chip, so it may not be able to process sales right now.

**Chip setup for T1988B** [sup-duvidas-06]:
1. With the machine off, open the back cover.
2. Insert the chip in the SIM1 or SIM2 slot, metal side facing down.
3. Close the cover, turn the machine on and wait for the data network to connect.
4. When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), the machine is ready. Then run a communication test.

Getnet has downloadable manuals for each model [sup-manual-maquinas-01]. The sources I found don't cover Wi-Fi connection or fixing a weak or missing signal.

I can propose a support ticket for T1988B, but nothing is opened until you confirm. I can also hand your case to a human agent. Would you like either?

rows.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
rows.answer:
You can split a sale into up to 48 installments with the Crediário [prod-crediario-03][prod-crediario-01]. The maximum term and the interest rate depend on the card issuer [prod-crediario-02].

You receive the full amount of the sale in a single payment within 2 business days after the transaction is captured, however many installments the cardholder chooses. The discount fee (MDR) is subtracted from the original transaction amount [sup-duvidas-39].

rows.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
rows.answer:
Yes, you can sell through WhatsApp with the Payment Link. It generates a link that your customer uses to pay online by card, Pix or debit. It is meant for sales over WhatsApp, social media and remote charges [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-02, prod-link-de-pagamento-01].

Pricing depends on your plan [prod-link-de-pagamento-02]:
- **Inicial:** R$1,00 per paid link, charged only when the payment is approved.
- **Básico:** R$28 per month, which covers 60 card transactions. Each extra transaction costs R$0,50.

rows.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
rows.answer:
The Get Clássica costs R$ 79,90/month and the Get Smart costs R$ 129,90/month [prod-ofertas-maquininha-11].

The Get Smart is a card machine that runs on Android. On the device you can:
- manage stock
- place orders
- close tabs
- load a menu
- issue invoices

[sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-17]

It also replaces the computer and fiscal printer at the counter. It reconciles payments in all modalities: credit, debit, crediário, QR Code and cash [sup-duvidas-get-smart-08].

Sales on both machines count toward the revenue figure used in the rental offer [prod-ofertas-maquininha-11].

The sources don't describe the Get Clássica's features, so I can't compare the two point by point. I can pass your case to a human agent if you'd like.

rows.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
rows.answer:
You need an account to receive your sales, but it doesn't have to be a bank account. Getnet offers Get Conta, a free digital account for your business. You can use it to send and receive money and to sell via Pix [sup-duvidas-42].

- Once you open Get Conta, it can be your bank domicile. You then receive sales within 2 business days of the transaction and of completing your registration [prod-ofertas-maquininha-13].
- If you aren't eligible for Get Conta, you can name another bank domicile in Getnet's digital channels. You still qualify for the offer's discounts [prod-ofertas-maquininha-13].
- Pix itself works with checking accounts, savings accounts or prepaid payment accounts [sup-duvidas-59].

The sources don't say which other banks or account types Getnet accepts as a bank domicile for Pix settlement. A human agent can confirm that if you'd like.

rows.message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
replans: records:need->faq (terminal offline/sem sinal: o passo a passo vem do manual de conexão)
rows.answer:
Your terminal T1988B (Get Clássica) is offline. It connects by chip and shows no signal, and it has been offline for 5 hours. Your other terminal, T1988A, is online.

To fix T1988B, start with the chip:
- With the machine off, open the back cover. Insert the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down [sup-duvidas-06].
- Close the cover, turn the machine on, and wait for it to connect to the data network [sup-duvidas-06].
- When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), the machine is ready to use [sup-duvidas-06].
- Then run a communication test to check that the chip is connected [sup-duvidas-06].

Some models connect by Chip + Wi-Fi. Each model has its own user manual, which you can download from the manual page [sup-manual-maquinas-01].

The sources I found don't cover the Wi-Fi steps, the communication test steps, or what to do about weak signal.

I can propose a support ticket for T1988B with the reason "sem_conexao". It is only a proposal until you confirm it, and it expires after 15 minutes if you don't. Do you want me to propose it? I can also hand your case to a human agent.

O que é a Get Smart?
A Get Smart é uma máquina de cartões inteligente. Com ela, seu dia a dia fica mais simples, fácil e muito mais digital. Você pode controlar o estoque, fazer pedidos, fechar conta, embarcar cardápio, emitir nota fiscal, tudo diretamente na máquina. A Get Smart permite que você integre o terminal com o sistema de seu estabelecimento e assim terá todos os aparelhos que seu negócio precisa em um único lugar.

rows.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
rows.answer:
You can advance your sales through the Getnet Brasil app, which is always available for that. The app charges no extra fees [sup-duvidas-17].

- **Automatic Advance (Antecipação Automática):** this is a condition for the exemption on the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" receiving plan. It involves credit approval, so Getnet assesses each contract individually and decides whether to grant it [sup-duvidas-102].
- **Through this assistant:** I can propose an advance request on your scheduled receivables. You would have to confirm it first, and then a human agent would have to approve it before it runs.

The sources don't give the advance fee, the payout timing, or the step-by-step process in the app. I can pass you to a human agent for those details if you'd like.

rows.message: My card machine is showing a transaction decline error.
replans: records:need->faq (terminal offline/sem sinal: o passo a passo vem do manual de conexão)
rows.answer:
Your two recent declines came from the card or the issuing bank, not from the terminals.

- **TX1007** (T1988A, credit, R$ 210,00): code 51 means insufficient funds or credit limit on the customer's card. Ask for another card or payment method.
- **TX1008** (T1988B, debit, R$ 75,00): code 05 means the issuing bank did not authorize the transaction. The cardholder should contact the issuing bank or try another card.

T1988A is online with a good signal. T1988B has been offline for 5 hours, since 2026-11-03 18:01, and that is a separate problem. To check the chip on T1988B:
- Turn the machine off and open the back cover. Insert the chip in the SIM1 or SIM2 slot, metal side down. [sup-duvidas-06]
- Close the cover, turn the machine on, and wait for it to connect to the data network. [sup-duvidas-06]
- When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), it's ready. Then run a communication test. [sup-duvidas-06]

Getnet has downloadable manuals for each model. [sup-manual-maquinas-01]

The sources I found don't cover Wi-Fi setup or signal troubleshooting.

I can propose a support ticket for T1988B for the lost connection. Nothing runs until you confirm it. Do you want me to propose it? I can also hand you to a human agent.

- Lookups the assistant runs immediately, only on the authenticated customer's data: get_settlements (Agenda de depósitos das vendas aprovadas do cliente autenticado: datas de depósito (dia útil), totais e contagens já calculados.); get_transactions (Vendas e recusas do cliente autenticado, com o significado do código de recusa, contagens e totais calculados.); get_terminal_status (Terminais do cliente autenticado: conexão, sinal, último contato e há quanto tempo está offline.).
- Actions the assistant can PROPOSE; nothing runs until the customer confirms the proposal: open_support_ticket (Abre chamado técnico para um terminal do cliente. Exige confirmação.).

- An action proposal that is not confirmed expires after 15 minutes.
- Hand the case to a human agent: opens a case with a ticket number; the agent's reply shows up in this same conversation.
- A decision on an individual case (dispute, block or release of a held amount) belongs to a human agent; the assistant does not decide it.
- Apart from these tools, the assistant does not carry out any action in the system.

rows.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
rows.answer:
With the Crediário, you can split a sale into up to 48 installments on a credit card [prod-crediario-03][prod-crediario-01]. The card issuer sets the maximum number of installments and the interest rate [prod-crediario-02].

You receive the full sale amount at once, within 2 business days after the transaction is captured, whatever the number of installments. The discount fee (MDR) is subtracted from the original amount [sup-duvidas-39].

rows.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
rows.answer:
Yes, you can sell through WhatsApp with the Payment Link. It generates a link your customer uses to pay online. It is meant for WhatsApp sales, social networks and remote charges [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-02, prod-link-de-pagamento-01].

- **Payment methods:** credit card (in full or in installments), debit card, Pix, Wallet and boleto [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-04].
- **Cost:** you pay only when you use the link, according to your contracted plan [prod-ofertas-maquininha-08].

rows.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
rows.answer:
The Get Clássica costs R$ 79,90/month and the Get Smart costs R$ 129,90/month [prod-ofertas-maquininha-11][prod-todas-as-maquininhas-04].

The Get Smart is a smart card machine that runs on Android. You can use it directly on the device to manage inventory, place orders, close tabs, load menus and issue invoices [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-17]. It can also integrate with your business system. It works as both computer and fiscal printer, so the counter stays cleaner [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-08]. Getnet processes all Get Smart sales [sup-duvidas-get-smart-17].

The sources don't describe the Get Clássica's features, so I can't compare the two beyond price. If you'd like, I can pass you to a human agent for more detail.

A Get Smart é uma máquina de cartões inteligente. Com ela, seu dia a dia fica mais simples, fácil e muito mais digital. Com um sistema de gestão integrado ele permite que não tenha a necessidade de deslocamento para consultar um estoque, o mesmo pode ser consultado diretamente na máquina. rows.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
rows.answer:
You need an account to receive your sales, but it doesn't have to be a bank account. Getnet offers Get Conta, a free digital account for your business. You can use it to receive your sales and to sell through Pix [sup-duvidas-42].

- Once you open it, Get Conta can be your bank domicile. You receive sales within 2 business days of the transaction and of completing your registration [prod-ofertas-maquininha-13].
- If you aren't eligible for Get Conta, you can name another bank domicile in Getnet's digital channels [prod-ofertas-maquininha-13].
- Pix works with checking accounts, savings accounts, or prepaid payment accounts [sup-duvidas-59].

rows.message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
replans: records:need->faq (terminal offline/sem sinal: o passo a passo vem do manual de conexão)
rows.answer:
Your T1988B (Get Clássica) is offline. It connects by chip, shows no signal, and has been offline for about 5 hours. Your other terminal, T1988A, is online.

For T1988B, check the chip first:
- With the machine off, open the cover on the back [sup-duvidas-06].
- Insert the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down [sup-duvidas-06].
- Close the cover, turn the machine on, and wait for it to connect to the data network [sup-duvidas-06].
- When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), it's ready to use. Then run a communication test to confirm the chip is connecting [sup-duvidas-06].
- To turn it on, press the green key on some models or the up-arrow key on others. To turn it off, press the "." key and the yellow key together for 2 seconds [sup-duvidas-66].

Getnet also has user manuals by machine model [sup-manual-maquinas-01].

The sources don't cover Wi-Fi setup or fixing a weak signal.

O que é a Get Smart?
A Get Smart é uma máquina de cartões inteligente. Com ela, seu dia a dia fica mais simples, fácil e muito mais digital. Você pode controlar o estoque, fazer pedidos, fechar conta, embarcar cardápio, emitir nota fiscal, tudo diretamente na máquina. A Get Smart permite que você integre o terminal com o sistema de seu estabelecimento e assim terá todos os aparelhos que seu negócio precisa em um único lugar.

[policy:capabilities] Capabilities and action policy of this assistant (generated from the system's tool registry):
- Lookups the assistant runs immediately, only on the authenticated customer's data: get_settlements (Agenda de depósitos das vendas aprovadas do cliente autenticado: datas de depósito (dia útil), totais e contagens já calculados.); get_transactions (Vendas e recusas do cliente autenticado, com o significado do código de recusa, contagens e totais calculados.); get_terminal_status (Terminais do cliente autenticado: conexão, sinal, último contato e há quanto tempo está offline.).
- Actions the assistant can PROPOSE; nothing runs until the customer confirms the proposal: open_support_ticket (Abre chamado técnico para um terminal do cliente. Exige confirmação.).
- High-risk actions: they need the customer's confirmation AND then the approval of a human agent (operator) before they run: request_receivables_advance (Solicita antecipação dos recebíveis agendados. Exige confirmação do cliente e aprovação de um atendente.).
- An action proposal that is not confirmed expires after 15 minutes.
- Hand the case to a human agent: opens a case with a ticket number; the agent's reply shows up in this same conversation.
- A decision on an individual case (dispute, block or release of a held amount) belongs to a human agent; the assistant does not decide it.
- Apart from these tools, the assistant does not carry out any action in the system.
- Identifiers the lookups accept: transaction_id = Id da transação (ex.: TX1007) (ex.: TX0000); terminal_id = Id do terminal (ex.: T1988A) (ex.: T0000A).

rows.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
rows.answer:
You can advance your sales through the Getnet Brasil app, which is always available for that and has no extra fee [sup-duvidas-17]. The app is the only advance channel the sources name.

- **Automatic Advance:** This is a separate product. It's a condition for the exemption for customers on the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" receiving plan. It involves credit approval, so Getnet reviews each contract individually and may or may not grant it [sup-duvidas-102].
- **Request through this assistant:** I can propose a receivables advance request for your scheduled receivables. It only runs after you confirm it and a human agent approves it.

The sources don't give the advance rate or the settlement timing, so I can't quote either one. A human agent can help with those if you'd like.

replans: records:need->faq (terminal offline/sem sinal: o passo a passo vem do manual de conexão)
rows.answer:
Your two recent declines came from the card or the bank, not from the terminals. Both happened yesterday (2026-11-02).
- **TX1007**: credit, R$ 210,00, on T1988A, code 51. This means insufficient funds or credit limit on the customer's card. Ask the customer for another card or payment method.
- **TX1008**: debit, R$ 75,00, on T1988B, code 05. The issuing bank did not authorize it (generic decline). The cardholder should contact their bank or try another card.

Separately, terminal T1988B (chip) is offline with no signal. Its last contact was 2026-11-03 at 18:02. T1988A is online with good signal.

To reconnect T1988B using the chip steps in the sources [sup-duvidas-06][sup-duvidas-07]:
1. With the machine off, open the back cover.
2. Insert the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, metal side facing down.
3. Close the cover, turn the machine on, and wait for it to connect to the data network.
4. When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), it is ready to use.
5. Run a communication test. Press the function button (F, # or the one on your machine), then choose option 2 (maintenance), then option 1 (communication test).

I can propose a support ticket for T1988B. It would only be a proposal, and nothing runs until you confirm.

The sources don't cover Wi-Fi setup or signal troubleshooting. If you need that, I can hand your case to a human agent.

rows.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
rows.answer:
With the Crediário, you can split a sale into up to 48 installments on a credit card [prod-crediario-03][prod-crediario-01]. The maximum number of installments and the interest rate depend on the card issuer [prod-crediario-02].

You receive the full sale amount at once, within 2 business days after the transaction is captured, however many installments the customer chooses. The discount fee is deducted from the original amount [sup-duvidas-39].

rows.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
rows.answer:
Yes, you can sell through WhatsApp with the Payment Link. It generates a link that your customer pays online with card, Pix or debit. It's meant for sales over WhatsApp, social networks and remote charges [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-02][prod-link-de-pagamento-01].

To create one:
1. Open the Minha Conta portal, or the Getnet Brasil app.
2. Go to Products and Services, select Payment Link, then Create Payment Link.
3. Fill in the product, shipping and payment options.
4. Click share or copy, and send the link wherever you like [prod-link-de-pagamento-04].

You pay only when you use the link, according to your contracted plan [prod-ofertas-maquininha-08]. The page shows a 1.90% rate, but the sources don't say which plan or channel it applies to [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-02]. I can hand you to a human agent to confirm your exact rate.

failures.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
failures.answer:
The sources don't say a bank account is mandatory. They do say Pix works with a checking, savings or prepaid payment account, at different banks [sup-duvidas-59]. Getnet also offers Get Conta, a free digital account for your business. With it you can send and receive money and sell through Pix [sup-duvidas-42].

You receive Pix payments by generating a QR Code on the capture devices: physical terminals, TEF Auttar and Ecommerce [sup-duvidas-84].

The sources don't state whether a specific account is required to receive Pix sales on Getnet. I can pass your question to a human agent if you'd like.

- [policy:capabilities] Capabilities and action policy of this assistant (generated from the system's tool registry):
- Lookups the assistant runs immediately, only on the authenticated customer's data: get_settlements (Agenda de depósitos das vendas aprovadas do cliente autenticado: datas de depósito (dia útil), totais e contagens já calculados.); get_transactions (Vendas e recusas do cliente autenticado, com o significado do código de recusa, contagens e totais calculados.); get_terminal_status (Terminais do cliente autenticado: conexão, sinal, último contato e há quanto tempo está offline.).
- Actions the assistant can PROPOSE; nothing runs until the customer confirms the proposal: open_support_ticket (Abre chamado técnico para um terminal do cliente. Exige confirmação.).
- High-risk actions: they need the customer's confirmation AND then the approval of a human agent (operator) before they run: request_receivables_advance (Solicita antecipação dos recebíveis agendados. Exige confirmação do cliente e aprovação de um atendente.).
- An action proposal that is not confirmed expires after 15 minutes.
- Hand the case to a human agent: opens a case with a ticket number; the agent's reply shows up in this same conversation.
- A decision on an individual case (dispute, block or release of a held amount) belongs to a human agent; the assistant does not decide it.
- Apart from these tools, the assistant does not carry out any action in the system.
- Identifiers the lookups accept: transaction_id = Id da transação (ex.: TX1007) (ex.: TX0000); terminal_id = Id do terminal (ex.: T1988A) (ex.: T0000A).
- Values the lookups and actions accept (closed list: no other value is accepted): get_settlements — period (padrão yesterday): yesterday | today | last_7_days; method: debito | credito | pix · get_transactions — status: all | approved | declined; period (padrão last_7_days): yesterday | today | last_7_days · request_receivables_advance — method: debito | credito | pix · open_support_ticket — reason: sem_conexao | sem_sinal | erro_transacao | outro.
